tools.name: search
tools.description: Search one network of websites (courses on any subject, a multilingual dictionary and encyclopedia, live disaster warnings, visa rules, everyday tools) for the pages that answer a query. Returns up to 8 results, each with an id to pass to fetch, a title and an address a person can open. Use it when

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one page found with search (or any page of a site of this network): its title, its text and its address, for quoting and citing. Takes the id search returned. It reads pages of this network only; any other address is refused.

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: From the first words of a subject (a prefix is enough), the pages of the network that answer it: pages being looked up right now first, then the site whose subject it is. Returns up to 8 { title, url, site, line }. With no words it returns what is being looked up right now.

tools.name: list_trending_pages
tools.description: What people around the World are looking up right now (search trends, most-read subjects, the day's events) and the page of the network that answers each, newest first. Each page was opened and checked before it was listed. Use it when the user asks what is trending or what people are looking up now

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Every site of the network with what it answers and its address.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
